info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Market Research Data API
info.description: The Financial Market Research Data API provides users with access to comprehensive financial market research insights. This API enables clients to retrieve detailed market data, including trends, historical performance, and analysis of various financial instruments. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, investment managers, and research teams seeking to enhance their decision-making capabilities with reliable market data. Users can expect to leverage this information for investment strategies, market assessments, and reporting purposes.

get.description: Fetch detailed financial market research data for resource RES-100045. This endpoint provides insights into market trends, analysis, and other relevant financial information that can assist in making informed investment decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized for retrieving financial market research data related to the specified resource. Ensure that all required parameters are provided in the expected format.

200.description: Successfully retrieved financial market research data.

GetMarketDataFinancialMarketResearchRes1.description: Represents the request body for operations related to GET requests in the financial market research context.

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument.

isin.description: The International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) of the instrument.

marketIdentifierCode.description: The code representing the market where the instrument is traded.

asOf.description: The timestamp indicating the date and time as of which the data is relevant.

dataSource.description: The source from which the data was obtained.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: The version number of the data record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the record was last updated.

GetMarketDataFinancialMarketResearchRes1.description: Schema representing the response for the financial market research operation.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: An identifier used to correlate requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the data was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region in which the data was processed.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the API endpoint that was accessed. This header assists in tracking and analytics.
